'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Nick Reisch DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

Typed printout (not a handwritten Xerox form).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Must Be Allowed To Speak]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
